findings.problem: Windows-derived report/CSV CRLF would be normalized by Git after artifact hashes were recorded
findings.fix: Explicit LF writers, normalize only audit-produced files, verify SHA against staged Git blobs before publication.

findings.problem: Retained partition Restore kept discarded RAM-tail timing buffers
findings.fix: Clear tick clocks and batchTimings after successful Restore. Real-SQL regression: before fix 4 traces instead of 3; after fix 3 traces, 3 fragments, next_offset=56, exact continuous mathematical snapshot. All six healthy controls had 16 initial restores only and were unaffected.

findings.problem: GET /v1/events returned HTTP 400 on unavailable storage
findings.fix: Validate query separately and report unavailable storage as 503; closed-pool regression verifies 400/503 distinction.

findings.problem: Historical input lag falsely measured as zero: prefix length mismatch
findings.fix: HasPrefix aggregation + nonzero regression; historical CSV zeros removed, original JSON preserved with invalidity overlay; reanalysis cannot certify legacy aggregates.

findings.problem: Resume ignored global input/golden config and build overwrote binaries
findings.fix: Verify actual SHA and config binding, lazy build, immutable bin/build-* with exact paths+SHA
findings.remaining: Legacy binary paths not recorded; some old binaries cannot be revalidated and are explicitly NOT_VERIFIED.

findings.problem: Timing analyzer could accept partial tick traces
findings.fix: Require count == independent comparison raw rows.

findings.problem: Owned HTTP idle pools not closed; output sender leaked on input startup failure
findings.fix: Close owned HTTP transport; dispatcher Close once also covers startup failure; targeted socket/startup/race tests.

findings.problem: Historical transport concurrency differs (Push concurrent vs Kafka/Polling sequential)
findings.fix: Explicit combined queue semantics, rehashed real traces, two-trial one-Worker control with sequential intake; no performance optimization of scientific/checkpoint pipeline.

findings.problem: Single-trial scaling, single-host conditions, limited transport replications
findings.fix: Six matched control runs and observed ranges, no fabricated CI; KR16 remains PARTIAL.

findings.problem: Upgrade path did not explicitly seed V5 durable progress; delta30 crash did not explicitly assert held historical witness
findings.fix: Real V5→V7 exact-row preservation test; real process-kill assertion of pre-crash historical positive witness.

findings.problem: Two diagnostic completion timeouts under initial concurrent audit load
findings.fix: Preserved initial FAIL; unchanged isolated tests and full final Worker race PASS; checks not relaxed.
